title: SARS Schedule 1 Part 1, General rate (applies to goods originating in China)
anti_dumping_check: Schedule 2 dated 2026-10-09 lists no anti-dumping, countervailing or safeguard duty on these headings.
caveat: Reference only. The rate depends on the exact classification (fibre, knitted vs woven, rubber vs PVC). Confirm with your clearing agent or a SARS tariff determination. Rates change by Government Gazette.

rates.category: 针织运动套装 knitted tracksuits
针织外套/风衣 knitted anoraks
夹克/西装上衣 jackets & blazers
收腹裤/塑身衣 girdles & shapewear
塑料制品(含PVC桌布?) plastic tableware
橡胶热水袋 rubber hot water bottles

vat.base: ATV = customs value (FOB) + 10% of customs value + customs duty

valuation.basis: FOB: price at the Chinese port, including inland freight in China; international freight and insurance excluded only if shown separately and documented

allin_example.note: How forwarders tier all-in (双清包税) prices: one Shenzhen forwarder's published South Africa sea rates, 2026-04-23, self-collect in Johannesburg, RMB per CBM: general goods 1,450; clothing, knitted hats, fabric 3,450. Your forwarder's prices will differ.
